title: pov: you saw ghost quartet in a cemetery and it changed you forever 🕯...
transcript: I'm going to be seeing my favorite musical in a cemetery part 2 but look this time look at the sky on thursday, I had tickets to see dave malloy's ghost quartet with the entire original cast including dave malloy at the green-wood cemetery I've been excited for this for literally weeks there was lightning and they ended up canceling it they ended up doing a couple of the songs for us in the parking lot it was like so special I posted videos but today sunday is the rain delay show the sky is blue it's actually quite hot I have my neck fan we made it inside green-wood it is still beautiful out they're doing whiskey tastings they're doing snacks alexa’s here with her snacks it's at the top of this hill show starts like at 8 as the sun setting I'm so excited love death and whiskey course through the veins of this amazing work that was so cool that was like one of my favorite theatre moments of the whole year as the sun was setting there were like I'm not joking thousands of fireflies thousands like they were everywhere they were like landing on it was like it was so cool dave and brent and brittain and gelsey what they've made is like really just special show and it means so much to me and it's so weird and just so lovely and the music is so fun I'm so glad I got to go back I'm so glad I got to see it what a night
